labels.defaultBody: This dialog uses the default md size and default appearance.
labels.sizeBody: The same content makes each supported width preset easy to compare.
labels.fullscreenBody: Fullscreen fills the viewport. Its content remains owned by the dialog component.
labels.appearanceBody: The appearance sets the optional icon color. The panel keeps its surface styling.
labels.noCloseBody: The container close button is hidden. Escape and backdrop dismissal still work.
labels.lockedBody: Escape and backdrop dismissal are disabled. Choose an action to close this dialog.
labels.titleExampleBody: This concise title stays clear of the close control.
labels.longBodyIntro: The body scrolls while the dialog header and footer remain visible.
labels.longBodyParagraph: This fixed paragraph is repeated to create a deterministic body that exceeds the dialog height and can be scrolled independently.
labels.unnamedBody: This dialog has no title. The container uses its generic accessible name fallback.
labels.confirmBody: The confirmation resolves with a boolean result.
labels.warningConfirmBody: Custom settings will return to their defaults.
